title: Common Problems
markdown:
| Problem | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| The example from the docs does not compile | docs for a different version, or a missing header | check the version marker and the Requirements section | 2.04, 5.03 |
| The search result shows old behaviour | an old page or forum answer | open the official reference and pick your version | 1.01 |
| A call does something different from what you expected | a different overload was chosen | match your arguments to the numbered overloads | 1.03 |
| A program works in Debug and crashes in Release | undefined behaviour the page warned about | find the precondition you broke | 1.04 |
| A value was not updated in a map | `insert` or `try_emplace` used to update | use `insert_or_assign` or `operator[]` | 2.02 |
| `"12abc"` was accepted as a number | `std::stoi` stops at the first bad character | use `std::from_chars` and check `ptr` reached the end | 2.01 |
| A crash after `push_back` or `erase` | an iterator or reference was invalidated | follow the container's invalidation rules | 2.03 |
| A Windows path or string is cut off | a truncated result was treated as success | check for the documented truncation result and grow the buffer | 3.01 |
| A buffer overrun with a wide string | bytes passed where characters were expected, or the reverse | read whether the size is `cch` or `cb` | 3.02 |
| `GetLastError` returns a meaningless value | read too late, or after a function that returns its own code | read it at once, and only when the page says to | 3.03 |
| A COM call "failed" with `S_FALSE` | tested `hr == S_OK` | use `SUCCEEDED(hr)` and handle `S_FALSE` as documented | 3.03 |
| A Windows call fails with `ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER` | `cbSize` not set, or flags combined wrongly | zero-initialise, set the size, check "one of" vs "one or more of" | 3.04 |
| Python `x = x.sort()` makes `x` None | `sort` works in place and returns `None` | use `x.sort()` or `x = sorted(x)` | 4.01 |
| JavaScript sorts numbers wrongly | the default sort compares strings | pass a compare function | 4.02 |
| A function returns nothing useful and has no docs | undocumented library | read the header, tests and source; write a learning test | 4.03 |
| Your parser rejects input another program accepts | a MAY or SHOULD in the spec was treated as MUST | sort the spec's sentences by RFC 2119 keyword | 4.04 |
| Code copied from an example leaks or crashes on errors | examples skip error handling | follow the adaptation routine | 5.01 |
| An upgrade broke something with no error | a behaviour change listed in the changelog | read every changelog entry between the versions | 5.03 |
| An AI or forum answer uses a function that does not exist | an invented or outdated answer | check every function on its reference page | 5.03 |
